title: Native quotient-system open tensor models and finite evaluation predicate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with its actual quotient rings $A_{n+1}$ and quotient homomorphisms [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the small pro-etale sites and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], their vertical quotient sequence rings [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and the recorded tensor models and finite evaluation calculus [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. For an open immersion $j:X\to Z$, use the actual native exact open extension $F=j_!$ and inverse image $G=j^*$ with their ordinary adjunction, site base-change functor and inverse-image unit on sections [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Define $\mathrm{SystemOpenModel}(j,S_X,S_Z)$ to be the normalized representative data of [def-sf-open-tensor-representative-data] specialized to these actual quotient sequence sites and tensor structures. Define $\mathrm{FiniteOpenModel}(j,S_X,S_Z,n)$ by the identical specialization at the constant finite ring $A_{n+1}$, using the recorded strict-tower single-ring open adjunction and its section unit [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Extract $\gamma$ from each of these data by its actual structure projection. Define $\mathrm{GammaEvaluation}$ for given system data $O$ and finite data $O_n$ to mean that, for every $n$ and all unbounded derived $U$ on $X$ and $L$ on $Z$, evaluation of $\gamma^O_{U,L}$ equals $\gamma^{O_n}_{e_nU,e_nL}$ under the specified tensor, open-extension and inverse-image evaluation isomorphisms. Concretely, on the source use tensor evaluation and the open evaluation on the first factor; on the target use open evaluation, tensor evaluation inside open extension, and the inverse-image evaluation on the second factor. This is a definition of data and a compatibility predicate, not an existence assertion.
